description: Compute the dollar penalty cost of paying a loan off early, given its remaining payoff balance and a prepayment penalty structure: either a flat percent of the payoff balance, or a fixed number of months of interest at the loan's annual rate.

annualRatePercent.description: The loan's annual interest rate as a percent (required when penaltyType is "months-of-interest")

monthsOfInterest.description: Number of months of interest charged as the penalty (required when penaltyType is "months-of-interest")

penaltyPercent.description: Penalty as a percent of the payoff balance (required when penaltyType is "percent-of-balance")

name: calculate_loan_prepayment_penalty
